record.final_answer:
18 GB.

Ferrocache's sizing guide (5.2, docs.ferrocache.example/sizing, read 2026-06-02) says maxmemory bounds only the dataset — replication buffers, client output buffers and fragmentation come on top. So the rule is RAM ≥ 1.5x maxmemory on a node with replication (1.25x without). 12 GB × 1.5 = 18 GB.

With a replica on the node, 15 GB would be the non-replicated figure and would leave no headroom for the replication buffer.
